newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ/Ansett to streamline international flights.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ/Ansett to streamline international flights.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Tuesday its passengers would have streamlined access to about 300 Ansett Australia flights a week on the 17 most popular inter-city connections within Australia.

Under new code sharing agreements, effective today, passengers transferring to these code-share flights would be able to check in luggage and receive all boarding passes through to their final destination at their departure from New Zealand.
Air NZ frequent flyers would be able to accumulate and redeem air points on Ansett Australia's domestic and international flights.
The two companies would be also be cooperating on common usage of airport hospitality lounges, Air NZ said.
Air NZ would also launch an advertising campaign on Wednesday on the ramifications of its purchase of 50 percent of Ansett.
Both airlines are reviewing all their flight schedules to identify opportunities for better connnections between, within and beyond Australia and New Zealand.
In a separate statement, News Ltd, owner of the other half of Ansett, said it had acquired Ansett New Zealand Ltd for an undisclosed sum.

The move was in line with a condition of the anti-monopoly New Zealand Commerce Commission, which specified that Ansett NZ be separated from Ansett to preserve competition in New Zealand airspace. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
